description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' in Java that provides static methods for logging messages with different priority levels and manages chaining of LogNode instances for custom logging behavior. It includes constants that map to Android's native Log levels and wrapper methods for logging with optional Throwable exceptions.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static logging methods and management of LogNode chain for customizable logging behavior.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to the provided node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message to the current LogNode chain with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
